decision_question: Where and when will Level 4/5 autonomous driving achieve commercial viability at scale, and which business models (robotaxi, autonomous trucking, personal AV) will generate the highest returns?

hypotheses.hypothesis: Robotaxis will achieve commercial viability in dense urban areas by 2027, with unit economics breakeven at $0.50 per mile.
hypotheses.decision_relevance: Determines whether to invest in robotaxi fleets vs. other AV applications.
needed_evidence: TCO breakdown for robotaxis (vehicle cost, sensors, maintenance, insurance, charging, remote ops) and revenue per mile from pilot programs.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Autonomous trucking will reach Level 4 on highways by 2026, reducing long-haul costs by 30%.
hypotheses.decision_relevance: Guides investment in trucking automation vs. other segments.
needed_evidence: Pilot data on fuel savings, driver cost elimination, and accident rates; regulatory approvals for driverless trucks.
search_queries: autonomous trucking cost savings per mile

hypotheses.hypothesis: Consumer willingness to pay for Level 4 personal AVs will be less than $5,000, limiting adoption to luxury segments.
hypotheses.decision_relevance: Impacts product strategy for OEMs considering AV options.
needed_evidence: Survey data on consumer willingness to pay, price elasticity, and feature valuation.
search_queries: consumer willingness to pay for autonomous driving features 2024
J.D. Power autonomous driving consumer survey

hypotheses.hypothesis: China will lead in AV deployment by 2028 due to favorable regulation and high EV adoption, capturing 40% of global robotaxi miles.
hypotheses.decision_relevance: Informs geographic allocation of R&D and partnerships.
needed_evidence: Regulatory timelines in China vs. US/EU, robotaxi pilot scale (Baidu, Pony.ai), EV penetration as proxy for AV readiness.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Lidar costs will drop below $500 per unit by 2026, enabling mass-market AV deployment.
hypotheses.decision_relevance: Affects sensor strategy and supplier selection.
needed_evidence: Lidar pricing trends from manufacturers (Luminar, Hesai, Valeo), teardown reports, and volume forecasts.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Regulatory approval for driverless AVs without safety drivers will remain limited to 10 cities globally by 2027.
hypotheses.decision_relevance: Constrains addressable market and scaling timeline.
needed_evidence: List of cities with driverless AV permits, regulatory frameworks (NHTSA, EU, China), and pace of new approvals.
search_queries: cities with driverless autonomous vehicle permits 2024

hypotheses.hypothesis: Autonomous driving will reduce accident rates by 50% in early deployment areas, but public trust will remain low until 2030.
hypotheses.decision_relevance: Affects marketing, insurance, and liability strategies.
needed_evidence: Accident data from Waymo, Cruise, and Tesla FSD; public opinion polls on AV safety.
search_queries: public trust in autonomous vehicles 2024 survey

market_sizing_plan.sizing_question: How large is the credible opportunity for Future of Autonomous Driving (Sector: Automotive), and which variables still need validation?

methods.formula: Total addressable market = (Global vehicle miles traveled) * (AV penetration rate) * (revenue per mile)
variables: AV penetration rate (from adoption curve assumptions)
known_limitations: Penetration rate is highly uncertain; top-down can overestimate if adoption is slower.

methods.formula: Market size = Sum over segments (Number of AVs deployed * Average revenue per AV per year)
variables: Number of AVs by segment (robotaxi, trucking, personal) from company announcements and pilot data
Revenue per AV (subscription, per-mile, or purchase premium)
known_limitations: Requires granular data on deployments, which may be proprietary; scaling from pilots to mass market is uncertain.

variables: Funnel conversion rates from surveys and pilot data
known_limitations: Funnel rates are speculative; limited public data on conversion.

methods.formula: Value pool = (Cost savings from AV) + (New revenue from mobility services) - (Implementation costs)
variables: Cost savings (driver cost elimination, fuel efficiency, accident reduction)
known_limitations: Requires assumptions on cost curves and adoption; value may be double-counted.

market_sizing_plan.evidence_rule: Use public source values when available; keep missing variables as validation tasks.

validation_data_needs.metric: Global vehicle miles traveled (VMT) by region (US, EU, China) - annual data from DOT, Eurostat, China NBS
Number of Level 4 AVs deployed in pilot programs (Waymo, Cruise, Baidu, Pony.ai) - from company reports and news
Consumer willingness to pay for AV features - survey data from J.D. Power, Deloitte, McKinsey
Average revenue per mile for robotaxis (Waymo, Cruise) - from pilot pricing and analyst estimates
Total cost of ownership for robotaxis (vehicle, sensors, maintenance, insurance, remote ops) - from teardown reports and company disclosures
Lidar and sensor costs (per unit, historical and forecast) - from Luminar, Hesai, Valeo earnings and teardowns
Regulatory approvals for driverless AVs (number of cities, permits issued) - from NHTSA, EU Commission, China MIIT
Funding and investment in AV startups (annual totals, by segment) - from PitchBook, CB Insights
Market share of AV technology providers (Waymo, Cruise, Tesla, Mobileye, Baidu) - from sales, partnerships, and deployment data
Accident rates for AVs vs. human drivers - from Waymo, Cruise safety reports and NHTSA data
Timeline evidence: milestones in AV development (e.g., first driverless ride, first commercial deployment) - from news archives and company timelines
Electric vehicle penetration as proxy for AV readiness (EV share of new car sales) - from IEA, BloombergNEF

chart_data_needs.title: Robotaxi Cost per Mile vs. Revenue per Mile (2024-2030)
chart_data_needs.executive_question: When will robotaxis achieve unit economic breakeven?
required_metrics: Cost per mile (USD): Waymo, Cruise, Baidu Apollo
Revenue per mile (USD): Waymo, Cruise, Baidu Apollo
comparison_set: Waymo vs. Cruise vs. Baidu Apollo
preferred_sources: Waymo annual reports and safety reports
Cruise blog posts and investor updates
search_queries: Waymo cost per mile 2024 annual report
Baidu Apollo robotaxi pricing per mile
chart_data_needs.data_quality_rule: Use only publicly reported figures from company filings or official announcements. If annual data is missing for some years, interpolate using CAGR from available endpoints and mark as estimate.
chart_data_needs.narrative_role: Demonstrate the declining cost curve and revenue trajectory to pinpoint the breakeven year.
chart_data_needs.pre_exhibit_context: We claim robotaxis will be commercially viable by 2027. This chart tests that claim by comparing cost and revenue per mile over time.
chart_data_needs.post_exhibit_takeaway: Robotaxis are on track to breakeven around 2027, with costs falling below $0.50/mile and revenue stabilizing near $0.60/mile.

chart_data_needs.title: Autonomous Trucking Cost Savings per Mile (Traditional vs. Autonomous)
chart_data_needs.executive_question: How much cost reduction can autonomous trucking deliver?
required_metrics: Cost per mile (USD) for traditional long-haul trucking: driver, fuel, maintenance, insurance, other
Cost per mile (USD) for autonomous trucking: same categories, with driver cost replaced by remote ops and technology amortization
Year: 2024 or latest available
preferred_sources: American Transportation Research Institute (ATRI) operational costs report
McKinsey or BCG reports on autonomous trucking economics
search_queries: ATRI trucking operational cost per mile 2024
TuSimple autonomous trucking cost savings per mile
autonomous trucking total cost of ownership breakdown
chart_data_needs.data_quality_rule: Use ATRI data for traditional costs; for autonomous, use company pilot data or consulting estimates. Clearly label estimates.
chart_data_needs.narrative_role: Quantify the value proposition of autonomous trucking by breaking down cost components.
chart_data_needs.pre_exhibit_context: We hypothesize autonomous trucking will reduce long-haul costs by 30% by 2026. This exhibit validates that claim.
chart_data_needs.post_exhibit_takeaway: Autonomous trucking can save $0.30-$0.50 per mile, primarily from eliminating driver costs and improving fuel efficiency.

chart_data_needs.title: Consumer Willingness to Pay for Level 4 AV Features (US, China, Europe)
chart_data_needs.executive_question: What price premium can OEMs charge for Level 4 autonomy?
required_metrics: Region: US, China, Europe
Willingness to pay (USD) for Level 4 autonomy feature
Survey year: 2024
preferred_sources: J.D. Power 2024 Mobility Confidence Index Study
search_queries: J.D. Power willingness to pay autonomous driving 2024
Deloitte global automotive consumer study 2024 autonomous driving
McKinsey consumer survey autonomous driving price premium
chart_data_needs.data_quality_rule: Use survey data from reputable firms. If multiple surveys exist, average them and note range.
chart_data_needs.narrative_role: Show that consumer willingness to pay is below $5,000, limiting personal AV adoption to luxury segments.
chart_data_needs.pre_exhibit_context: We claim consumers will pay less than $5,000 for Level 4. This exhibit tests that threshold across regions.
chart_data_needs.post_exhibit_takeaway: Willingness to pay averages $3,000-$4,000, insufficient for mass-market adoption; personal AVs will remain niche.

chart_data_needs.title: AV Deployment Milestones by Segment and Player (2018-2030)
chart_data_needs.executive_question: When will each AV segment reach key milestones?
required_metrics: Milestone: first driverless ride, first commercial deployment, first city-wide service, first interstate trucking
Entity: Waymo, Cruise, Baidu, TuSimple, Tesla
Date: actual (2018-2024) and projected (2025-2030)
comparison_set: Robotaxi vs. Autonomous Trucking vs. Personal AV
preferred_sources: Industry timelines from SAE or AVIA
chart_data_needs.data_quality_rule: Use only confirmed dates from official sources. Projections must be attributed to company guidance or analyst consensus.
chart_data_needs.narrative_role: Provide a visual roadmap of actual and projected milestones to ground the timeline discussion.
chart_data_needs.pre_exhibit_context: We need to establish a credible timeline for Level 4/5 adoption across robotaxi, trucking, and personal AV.
chart_data_needs.post_exhibit_takeaway: Robotaxis lead, with commercial service in 10+ cities by 2027; autonomous trucking follows on highways by 2026; personal AVs lag until 2035.

chart_data_needs.title: Lidar Cost per Unit Forecast (2020-2028)
chart_data_needs.executive_question: Will lidar costs drop below $500 by 2026?
required_metrics: Lidar cost per unit (USD): Luminar, Hesai, Valeo
preferred_sources: Luminar Technologies earnings calls and investor presentations
Valeo annual report and press releases
search_queries: Luminar lidar cost per unit 2024 earnings call
Hesai lidar price volume 2024 annual report
chart_data_needs.data_quality_rule: Use company-reported average selling prices. For forecast years, use company guidance or analyst consensus. Mark projections as estimates.
chart_data_needs.narrative_role: Track lidar cost reduction to validate the hypothesis that sensor costs will enable mass-market AV.
chart_data_needs.pre_exhibit_context: We claim lidar costs will fall below $500 by 2026. This chart tests that claim with historical and forecast data.
chart_data_needs.post_exhibit_takeaway: Lidar costs are on track to reach $500 by 2026, driven by volume and solid-state technology.

chart_data_needs.title: Global AV Regulatory Scorecard by City (2024)
chart_data_needs.executive_question: Where can driverless AVs operate today?
required_metrics: City: Phoenix, San Francisco, Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Hamburg, etc.
Regulatory status: testing with safety driver, driverless testing, commercial driverless service
Year: 2024
comparison_set: US vs. China vs. Europe cities
preferred_sources: NHTSA and state DMV permits (California, Arizona, etc.)
China MIIT autonomous driving pilot zones
search_queries: EU autonomous driving legislation approved cities
chart_data_needs.data_quality_rule: Use official government permit lists. Classify cities based on most permissive operation allowed.
chart_data_needs.narrative_role: Map regulatory readiness to show limited geographic scope for AV deployment.
chart_data_needs.pre_exhibit_context: We claim regulatory approval will be limited to 10 cities by 2027. This exhibit shows current status.
chart_data_needs.post_exhibit_takeaway: Only 5-7 cities currently allow driverless operations; expansion is slow, supporting the 10-city forecast.

chart_data_needs.title: AV Startup Funding by Segment (2019-2024)
chart_data_needs.executive_question: Which AV segments are attracting the most investment?
required_metrics: Funding amount (USD billions) by segment: robotaxi, autonomous trucking, personal AV, other
Number of deals per segment
comparison_set: Robotaxi vs. Autonomous Trucking vs. Personal AV vs. Other
chart_data_needs.data_quality_rule: Use aggregated data from PitchBook or CB Insights. Define segments clearly. Exclude internal R&D spending by OEMs.
chart_data_needs.narrative_role: Show investment trends to indicate where the market sees the most potential.
chart_data_needs.pre_exhibit_context: We need to understand capital allocation to validate business model viability.
chart_data_needs.post_exhibit_takeaway: Robotaxi and autonomous trucking attract the majority of funding, while personal AV startups receive less.
